title: fix(verify): bootStack composes the artifact-less MetadataPlugin os serve gives a host config, so declared apis endpoints answer under the harness
body:
Fixes #23088
Clause-②: no

`bootStack` now fills its `metadata` slot the way `objectstack serve` fills it for a host configuration: `@objectstack/metadata`'s `MetadataPlugin` with no artifact, the composition PR #23078 gave `serve`. Before, the slot was the kernel's in-memory fallback, which has no `matchEndpoint`. So a stack's declared `apis` answered `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` under the harness and their declared answer under `os serve`, and every such boot logged `AppPlugin`'s no-matcher warning.

**Patch round 1 is applied at `0c232d83fb`.** The seat's ruling (comment 6136737187) extended the claimed surface by two files, `packages/verify/vitest.config.ts` and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-validate-start-ordering.dogfood.test.ts`, and ruled the open question **A**. Two comment sentences rode the same round. `check:test-source-alias` and the moved precondition are green. The PR stays a draft for the seat. The whole dogfood suite has one red left: a `main`-side interaction of PR #22900 with PR #22993 that reds with or without this PR's composition (measured below).

## What changes

- **`packages/verify/src/harness.ts`, `bootStack`'s composition.**
  - It composes `new MetadataPlugin({ watch: false, config: { bootstrap: 'lazy' }, rootDir: hostRoot })`. These are the options `serve.ts` passes to `hostConfigMetadataDoor`, read at `:3335`-`:3347`: no `artifactSource`, no `artifactWatch`, `registerSystemObjects` left at its default.
  - The slot is right after `HonoServerPlugin` and before `AppPlugin`. That is `serve`'s order: HTTP server, then the door (`:3606`), then the app wrap and the app's plugins. As in `serve`, the `kernel.use` has no catch.
  - A `MetadataPlugin` the caller hands in `extraPlugins`, or one the app declares in its own `plugins`, takes the composed one's place. The check reads the two keys `serve`'s condition reads (`name === 'com.objectstack.metadata'`, or constructor name `MetadataPlugin`). In that case the door is never registered, so the kernel logs no supersede.
  - The docblock's composition sentence now names the plugin. Its exception list stays the two it names: the MCP endpoint and pinyin search.
- **`packages/verify/package.json`** gains `@objectstack/metadata` (`workspace:*`). `@objectstack/metadata` depends on neither `verify` nor `runtime`, so this adds no cycle (`check:workspace-manifest-cycles` exit 0). `pnpm-lock.yaml` was regenerated by `pnpm install`, as was the merge of `main` that brought PR #22993's `verify` dependency line.
- **`packages/verify/src/harness.metadata-door.test.ts`** (new; 2 cases, 2 boots).
  - The harness's own composition: the slot has `matchEndpoint`. The declared path answers `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` without a session and `200` with one. An undeclared path under the same mount answers `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`. No no-matcher warning is logged. The case asserts all of these as one composite.
  - A caller's `MetadataPlugin` in `extraPlugins`: the `metadata` service is that instance's manager (by identity), no supersede warning names `com.objectstack.metadata`, and the declared path answers `401`.
  - Warnings are matched by their structured fields (`appId`, `plugin`), never by their prose.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-declarative-endpoints.dogfood.test.ts`**: the hand-added artifact-backed `MetadataPlugin` is removed, and its header is corrected. The reason it goes:
  - The file's own stated intent is "boot the showcase the way a deployment boots it". The showcase is a host configuration, and `os serve` / `os start` of it now compose the artifact-less door (PR #23078). So the harness's own composition is that deployment. The old hybrid (an artifact door, with `AppPlugin` still the registrar) was a boot no production composition runs.
  - The file now pins `bootStack` of the showcase with no `MetadataPlugin` in `extraPlugins`: 401 without a session and 200 with one, on `GET /api/v1/apps/showcase/tasks`.
  - The artifact door's `apis:` ingestion keeps its own dogfood proofs: `declarative-endpoint-policy` and `declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest`, both green.
  - The stand-in artifact is still written through the build's own schema parse, so section 0 and the E7 publish-gate proof keep their subject.
- **`.changeset/23088-verify-bootstack-metadata-plugin.md`**: `@objectstack/verify` `patch`, with `Clause-②: no`.
- **`packages/verify/vitest.config.ts`** (patch round 1): the one anchored `@objectstack/metadata` alias that `check:test-source-alias` prescribes, beside the `core` entry.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-validate-start-ordering.dogfood.test.ts`** (patch round 1, option A): the precondition pins the composed door. The header drops the fallback framing and names the seam pin of the #21876 ordering repair. The federation cases are unchanged.
- **`multi-package-artifact.dogfood.test.ts`, `external-validate-sees-runtime-save.dogfood.test.ts`** (patch round 1): one comment sentence each.

## Reach, before

On `origin/main` `965a1bfc72`, `bootStack` of `examples/app-showcase` (`hostRoot` = the app, `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`):

- `GET /api/v1/apps/showcase/tasks` answered `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, both without a session and with one. `POST …/inquiries/purge` answered the same 404.
- The boot logged the warning once, with `{"appId":"com.example.showcase","count":2}`.
- The slot was the fallback: constructor `Object`, `matchEndpoint` undefined, `__serviceInfo.status` `degraded`.

## Census, before and after

How it was measured: a scratch script booted each app through the BUILT `@objectstack/verify`. BEFORE is the `965a1bfc72` build. AFTER is the build with only the composition commit (`a23a3b8cc6`) on top. Both ran under the shared verification lock. The script and its logs stayed in the scratchpad and are not committed.

| item | showcase BEFORE | showcase AFTER | crm BEFORE | crm AFTER |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `metadata` occupant | fallback (`degraded`, no `matchEndpoint`) | `NodeMetadataManager`, `matchEndpoint` | fallback | `NodeMetadataManager` |
| plugins on the kernel | 34 | 35 (+ `com.objectstack.metadata`) | 22 | 23 |
| declared `GET …/tasks`, no session | 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | **401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`** | n/a (no `apis`) | n/a |
| the same, admin session | 404 | **200, 10 records** | n/a | n/a |
| undeclared path under the mount | 404 | 404 | n/a | n/a |
| no-matcher warning | 1 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| `/meta/TYPE`, 22 types: status, count, body hash | baseline | **22 of 22 equal** | baseline | **22 of 22 equal** |
| security registrar | `Registered stack-declared security metadata` once, count 23 | same, once, 23 | once, 5 | once, 5 |
| `position` / `permission` / `capability` / `sharing_rule` on `/meta` | 16 / 17 / 11 / 2 | equal bodies | — | equal bodies |
| registry objects (`registerSystemObjects`) | 104 | 104 (the door logs `Registered system metadata objects` once, and the set does not grow) | 79 | 79 |
| `sys_metadata` / `_history` / `_commit` / `_audit` rows after boot | 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 | 0 each | 0 each |
| `hostRoot/.objectstack/metadata` written | no | no (`FileSystemRepository attached`, writes nothing) | no | no |
| `GET /api/v1/discovery`, `services.metadata.status` | `degraded` | **`available`** | `degraded` | **`available`** |
| `GET /api/v1/dev/metadata-events` | 404 | **200 `text/event-stream`** (development posture, as under `os dev`) | 404 | **200** |
| verify CRUD family summary | 24 objects / 15 verified / 1 needs fixture / 8 skipped / 0 gaps | identical | 6 / 4 / 1 / 1 / 0 | identical |
| verify RLS family summary | — | — | 6 objects, 6 probe-blocked | identical |
| boot, median of 7 interleaved boots (shared box) | 4750 ms | 4745 ms | — | — |

The four security collections keep one registrar, `AppPlugin` (`'app-plugin'`). The door reads none of the stack: `lazy bootstrap` is logged once, and no artifact is named. The CRM row is the CONTROL: a stack with no `apis` gives the same proof answers before and after.

Across the whole dogfood suite (next section), the two answers that move, discovery's `metadata` status and the development-only HMR route, are read by no pin.

## The dogfood suite, whole

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, under the lock:

- **at `0c232d83fb` (patch round 1, after merging `main`):** `Test Files  1 failed | 258 passed | 1 skipped (260)`, `Tests  2121 passed | 18 skipped (2139)`.
  - The one failed file is `mail-message-pool-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts`. It fails in its `beforeAll` (`fixture permission set mail_pool_22870_read seeded: expected undefined to be truthy`), so its 9 tests are skipped. **That red is not this PR's**, as measured below.
  - Every file this PR touches is green: `showcase-declarative-endpoints` 17/17, `external-validate-start-ordering` 3/3, `external-validate-sees-runtime-save` 3/3 and `multi-package-artifact` 9/9. The artifact-door proofs are green too: `declarative-endpoint-policy` 8/8 and `declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest` 6/6.
  - The no-matcher warning appears 0 times in the whole run's log.
- **Earlier, before the ruling:** at `d072256c13` `1 failed | 257 passed | 1 skipped (259)` files, and at `96eaff46d0` `1 failed | 256 passed | 1 skipped (258)` files. Both times the one red was the precondition that patch round 1 moved.

**The `mail-message-pool-read-gate` red, measured on this tree with and without the composition.** Both legs ran inside the lock, with a trap-armed restore.
- With the door, as built: `Test Files  1 failed (1)`, `Tests  9 skipped (9)`, the same assertion.
- With the door removed (blob `704910003254` → `5b13a59a72e7`, verify rebuilt, the marker preflight-absent from all 6 built files): the same `1 failed (1)`, `9 skipped (9)`, the same assertion.
- Restore: blob equal to HEAD, rebuilt, the marker present again, and `git status --porcelain` empty.
- The file was green in this branch's run at `82ccd6962d`. Between that head and this one, `main` landed PR #22900 ("no seeder or materializer writes a `sys_permission_set` row; the boot seeds no row for a declared set"), and this file's fixture reads such a row. So it is a `main`-side interaction of PR #22900 with PR #22993, which reds `main`'s full battery whatever this PR does. It is reported to the seat, not fixed here.

## Patch round 1: the seat's ruling (comment 6136737187)

The seat extended the claimed surface by two files and ruled the open question **A**. Each item is its own commit.

1. **`packages/verify/vitest.config.ts`** (`3867e0a312`): one anchored alias line beside the `core` entry, `{ find: /^@objectstack\/metadata$/, replacement: path.resolve(HERE, '../metadata/src/index.ts') }`. That is exactly the remedy `check:test-source-alias` prescribed, and the gate now prints `check-test-source-alias OK`.
2. **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-validate-start-ordering.dogfood.test.ts`** (`8b2647eb19`), option A:
   - The precondition case now asserts the composed door's identity and its matcher: `kernel.hasPlugin('com.objectstack.metadata')`, the `metadata` service `toBeInstanceOf(MetadataManager)` (`@objectstack/metadata`), and `matchEndpoint` a function.
   - The header drops the "`objectstack start` shape" and "the verify harness composes no metadata plugin" framing. It names the seam pin that holds the #21876 init-ordering fix: `packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/external-validate-reads-live-registry.test.ts`.
   - The `describe` title follows the header. The two federation cases are unchanged: the diff has no line inside either of them.
   - It uses no stand-in plugin and deletes nothing.
   - The pin bears weight: with the door removed, it reds at `hasPlugin` (`expected false to be true`), and the two federation cases stay green (ablation leg 3 below).
3. **Two comment sentences** (`cf2065001e`): `multi-package-artifact.dogfood.test.ts` about `:163` and `external-validate-sees-runtime-save.dogfood.test.ts` about `:24`. A non-comment-line filter over that commit's diff counts **0** changed lines outside `//` comments.

`main` was then merged (`480dcb717e`, and again `0c232d83fb` when it moved during the first lock wait). **The new head is `0c232d83fb`.** All the measurements below are at it.

## Ablations

Each leg ran inside `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor was `await kernel.use(new MetadataPlugin({ watch: false, config: { bootstrap: 'lazy' }, rootDir: hostRoot }));`, x1 → x0. Each restore was trap-armed and proved by the blob equal to HEAD (`704910003254`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **Leg 1: the verify test, source-resolved.** It ran in wrap mode, with blob `704910003254` → `082b863f6fb3`. Result: `Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)`.
  - The composite case received `matcher: "undefined"`, `anonymous: { status: 404, code: "ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND" }` and `signedIn: 404`.
  - It also received one matcher warning, carrying `{"appId":"com.example.mdoor","count":1}`.
  - The caller's-own-plugin case stayed green.
- **Leg 2: the showcase dogfood pin, which resolves `verify` through `dist/`.** The mutation was `void MetadataPlugin; // ablation-23088…`, blob → `8efaf19cc8cf`. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify build`, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/verify 'kernel.use(new MetadataPlugin(' --absent` read the marker as absent from all 6 built files.
  - Result: `Tests  7 failed | 10 passed (17)`. The 401 cases received `{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND"}` 404, and the run logged the showcase's warning once.
  - Restore: rebuild, and the preflight found the marker present again in `dist/index.js`, with the tree clean.
  - A first attempt at this leg never ran. Its plain comment replacement left the import unused, and the DTS build refused that (`TS6133`). The trap restored the file and the rebuilt dist. The successful run above is the second attempt, with the import kept referenced.
- **Leg 3 (patch round 1): the moved precondition, which resolves `verify` through `dist/`.**
  - Mutation, the same anchor: blob `704910003254` → `8efaf19cc8cf`. Then a rebuild, and the marker read absent from all 6 built files.
  - CONTROL run with the door, as built: `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  3 passed (3)`. Without the door: `Tests  1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. The precondition reds at `hasPlugin` (`expected false to be true`), and both federation cases stay green.
  - Restore: blob equal to HEAD, rebuilt, the marker present again, and `git status --porcelain` empty.

- The four security collections, `/meta`, persistence and the object set are unmoved (census). Two answers of a test boot move with the slot: discovery's `metadata` status, and the development-only HMR route. The changeset says so.
